description.value: Victoria Food & Florist is a long-standing neighbourhood shop on Cook Street that has operated as a flower establishment for over 30 years, recently renovated and revamped. Their seasonal floral arrangements are inspired by the natural beauty of BC's western coast, and the shop carries fresh-cut flowers, hanging baskets, and potted plants. It sits just minutes from the lively Cook Street Village, a well-known stop on Victoria's urban cycling network.
